plugins.name: imagineer
plugins.description: Make AI-built software trustworthy without trusting the AI. Inspect checks an existing repo: it asks you in plain words what the app should do, proves your answers with tests and tries to break it. Build makes new features with an Architect, a Dev and a QA agent. A pane shows the grade.
